task.summary:
Implement smart financial tracker with notification-based transaction analysis.
- Created `financial_tracker` module to capture and parse banking notifications using dynamic regex rules. - Implemented `AESEncryptionHelper` and `TransactionDao` for secure, local-first data storage with encryption. - Added `WalletConfigManager` to drive parsing logic via JSON configuration for various banking packages. - Built a reactive UI using Jetpack Compose featuring a unified dashboard, social debt ledger, and step-by-step onboarding. - Added administrative tools for reprocessing unparsed notification logs and managing battery optimization exemptions. - Established `AI_Agent_Core_Rules.md` to define architectural and privacy-first development principles.

Implement smart financial tracker with notification-based transaction analysis.
- Created `financial_tracker` module to capture and parse banking notifications using dynamic regex rules. - Implemented `AESEncryptionHelper` and `TransactionDao` for secure, local-first data storage with encryption. - Added `WalletConfigManager` to drive parsing logic via JSON configuration for various banking packages. - Built a reactive UI using Jetpack Compose featuring a unified dashboard, social debt ledger, and step-by-step onboarding. - Added administrative tools for reprocessing unparsed notification logs and managing battery optimization exemptions. - Established `AI_Agent_Core_Rules.md` to define architectural and privacy-first development principles.

Implement category persistence and manual transaction classification.
- Created `CategoryManager` to handle local storage and retrieval of custom categories using SharedPreferences and Gson. - Added `UnconfirmedTransactionCard` to the dashboard UI, allowing users to classify new transactions as expenses, income, or debts. - Enhanced `CategoriesCustomizationScreen` with a monthly expense analytics summary section and integrated persistent category management. - Updated `DynamicParser` to extract and process account balance information from notification data. - Refactored `DashboardViewModel` to support real-time transaction updates and classification persistence. - Updated `AppNavigation` to replace the placeholder "Wallets" route with the new "Categories" management interface. - Improved `CategoryMapper` with broader keyword matching for telecom services and renamed internal color constants for clarity.

Merge project histories and update parser SDK compatibility.
- Resolved "unrelated histories" merge conflict to unify project versions while maintaining the Android module structure. - Updated `DynamicParser` to conditionally use named regex capture groups only on Android Oreo (API 26) and higher to prevent runtime crashes. - Refactored `SplashScreen` animation logic to use Kotlin's `Duration` API (`milliseconds`) for improved readability and type safety. - Added a comprehensive project analysis document (`Deep_Project_Analysis_For_Non_Programmers.md`) covering architectural principles and privacy-first automation. - Created implementation artifacts documenting the Git workflow, task status, and merge walkthrough for the project history unification. - Updated IDE configuration files, including VCS directory mappings and module definitions.

Merge project histories and update parser SDK compatibility.
- Resolved "unrelated histories" merge conflict to unify project versions while maintaining the Android module structure. - Updated `DynamicParser` to conditionally use named regex capture groups only on Android Oreo (API 26) and higher to prevent runtime crashes. - Refactored `SplashScreen` animation logic to use Kotlin's `Duration` API (`milliseconds`) for improved readability and type safety. - Added a comprehensive project analysis document (`Deep_Project_Analysis_For_Non_Programmers.md`) covering architectural principles and privacy-first automation. - Created implementation artifacts documenting the Git workflow, task status, and merge walkthrough for the project history unification. - Updated IDE configuration files, including VCS directory mappings and module definitions.

Add sample app module and improve library compatibility.
- Created a new `:app` module to provide a runnable environment for verifying the `:financial_tracker` library's functionality. - Updated `DynamicParser` to safely handle named regex capture groups with fallbacks for Android versions below Oreo (API 26). - Added unit tests for `DynamicParser` to verify transaction parsing logic for various scenarios. - Configured the library's Gradle build to allow default values in unit tests, facilitating easier mocking of Android classes. - Integrated the `android-application` plugin and updated project-level configuration files to support the new module structure. - Cleaned up IDE configuration files and removed obsolete Flutter plugin references. - Updated project artifacts including the implementation plan and walkthrough to reflect the addition of the sample application.

Establish open-source foundation and project documentation.
- Added comprehensive project documentation including a bilingual (English/Arabic) `README.md`, `CONTRIBUTING.md`, `CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md`, and `SECURITY.md`. - Integrated the Apache License 2.0 to establish the project's legal framework. - Configured GitHub Actions for automated Android CI to run builds and tests on push and pull request events. - Standardized community contributions by adding templates for bug reports, feature requests, and pull requests. - Initialized repository settings with `.gitignore` and `.editorconfig` to ensure consistent environment and coding styles. - Renamed the root project to `smart-financial-tracker` and updated Gradle settings to reflect the new naming convention. - Added the `VIBRATE` permission to the `financial_tracker` module manifest. - Created implementation artifacts documenting the open-source readiness plan and task status. - Updated IDE configuration files to include the `:app` module and reflect the renamed project structure.

Modernize sample app with Jetpack Compose and integrate ktlint for code quality.
- Migrated the sample `:app` module from a View-based implementation to Jetpack Compose using Material 3. - Implemented `DashboardScreen`, `PermissionGuideScreen`, and a modern theme engine in the sample app to showcase library features. - Integrated the `ktlint` Gradle plugin across all modules to enforce consistent coding standards. - Performed a project-wide reformatting pass to ensure all Kotlin files adhere to ktlint styling rules. - Added a `CHANGELOG.md` to track project versions and updated the `README.md` with status badges for CI, License, and Version. - Updated the `financial_tracker` library manifest to include the missing `VIBRATE` permission. - Enhanced public API documentation with comprehensive KDoc for `FinancialTrackerClient` and the `FinancialTransaction` data model. - Added a basic UI test for the sample application to verify navigation and initial state. - Updated project artifacts and implementation plans to reflect the transition to a Compose-based architecture and industry-standard linting.

Expand project documentation and establish a long-term roadmap.
- Added `architecture.md` to document the library's event-driven flow, covering the notification listener service, dynamic parser engine, and reactive client API. - Created `security-deep-dive.md` detailing the implementation of AES-256 GCM encryption, Android KeyStore integration, and SHA-256 hashing for PII anonymization. - Introduced `ROADMAP.md` to outline future development phases, including AI-powered transaction classification, multi-bank presets, and cross-platform support. - Added `CONTRIBUTING_GUIDE.md` providing technical instructions for repository setup, adding new bank parser configurations, and enforcing code style via ktlint. - Updated `README.md` with a dedicated documentation section linking to the new technical guides and the project roadmap. - Refined internal project artifacts and task lists to reflect the completion of community engagement and technical documentation milestones.

Update IDE workspace configuration and switch active branch to master.
- Updated the `git-widget-placeholder` in `.idea/workspace.xml` to reflect a switch from the `add-new-feat` branch to `master`. - Cleaned up internal IDE change list metadata and pending file states in the workspace configuration.
